highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple OS 26.0 TFM support and a WinUI DLL resolution fix to the 3.x line.

bullets.lead: Apple OS 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported to 3.x
bullets.detail: The 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs introduced in 4.x are now available on the 3.119.x line, enabling consumers targeting the latest Apple platforms to stay on 3.x.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL resolution fixed for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: An error where the WinUI Projection DLL was not found at runtime on .NET 9 has been resolved, restoring WinUI app compatibility on 3.119.x.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple OS 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support to the 3.119.x release branch.
